column1: # Wiki image hold_ack ledger. Mirrors the vendor-tree hold_ack contract in
# when a wiki image's pinned CM044 sha sits behind live main HEAD -- the pin is
# treated as HELD (non-fatal) only if EVERY delta commit is listed here AND a
# written reason is given AND shipping_bugfixes_grafted is asserted true.
# Any un-acknowledged delta commit stays fail-closed RED, exactly like the
#   pinned_sha_prefix          8+ hex prefix of the CM044 source sha recorded
#                              digest. Row matches only if the current pin
#                              still starts with this prefix (defensive: a
#                              re-pin invalidates the ack, forcing a re-decision).
#   hold_ack_shas              Space-separated delta commits between the pin
#                              and live CM044 main HEAD (short or full hex).
#   shipping_bugfixes_grafted  Explicit human assertion: "true" if the
#                              bugfixes among the held commits are grafted
#                              into the shipped artefact by other means, or
#                              the next re-baseline. Empty / false = RED.
#   reason                     Written justification for the hold. REQUIRED --
#                              an empty reason keeps the pin RED.
# Comment lines (# or blank) are ignored. Multi-line values NOT supported;
# keep the reason to a single line (semicolons for structure).

v1.0.39 (2026-08-22 Archie). SAME ONE-COMMIT DELTA as the wiki-site row, AND THE ANSWER IS THE OPPOSITE ONE: docker/Dockerfile.compiler COPYs compiler/ wholesale, so ALL THREE delta files (compiler/compile.py, compiler/lint.py, compiler/tests/test_lint_excludes_nested_vault.py) ARE in this image and a rebuild WOULD change it. Same control as the site row (identity_label.py and requirements.txt both return IN-CONTEXT), so 3-of-3 is a real positive. THIS ACK THEREFORE CANNOT USE THE BYTE-IDENTICAL ARGUMENT every other row in this file uses. IT IS THE WEAKEST ROW IN THIS FILE AND IT SAYS SO RATHER THAN BORROWING ITS NEIGHBOUR'S LOGIC; it rests on the second limb of shipping_bugfixes_grafted, non-launch-blocking and carried forward on the next re-baseline. WHAT IS ACTUALLY HELD: a2b93d7 passes exclude_dirs into run_lint so the Obsidian vault, nested INSIDE the docs root on the shipped compose layout, stops being walked as site pages. run_lint's output is consumed at compile.py:1565-1577 for one log line and for lint-report.md, and nowhere else -- it does not feed page generation, so NO COMPILED PAGE CHANGES. The single customer-visible difference is lint-report.md, which today buries about 45 real orphans under roughly 13,378 phantom ones: a diagnostic getting better, not a break getting fixed, and not what v1.0.39 exists to ship (a frozen graph on every installed box). A CORRECTION TO MY OWN FIRST DRAFT OF THIS ROW, RECORDED BECAUSE THE WRONG VERSION IS THE DANGEROUS ONE: it said rebuilding was FORBIDDEN by Andy's ORDER 1 and that the live store held ZERO schema.ostler.ai triples. BOTH ARE STALE. That precondition was DISCHARGED 2026-08-21 -- the store was migrated (pwg.dev 30,345 -> 74, backup verified at 300,265 lines) and the wiki was re-pinned to CM044 9af6eca in CM051 #921. I read a block that GROUNDING labels '(HISTORICAL) ... do not act on it as state' and acted on it as state. Rebuilding IS permitted. SO THIS HOLD IS A JUDGEMENT, NOT A CONSTRAINT, and the judgement is: the wiki digests are pinned IN install.sh (lines 12966 and 13001), so a rebuild plus re-pin edits install.sh, which changes its blob, which invalidates the CM051 blob pin recorded in cuts/v1.0.39/cut.env, which forces a re-point and a fourth tag move. That cascade, to absorb a lint-report improvement, on a cut that has already failed three times and whose purpose is unfreezing a customer's graph, is the wrong trade tonight. It is a deliberate hold with a written reason, which is what this file is for, and it is NOT a claim that the rebuild is unavailable. SELF-INFLICTED AND NAMED AS SUCH: a2b93d7 is my own merge of CM044 #240 at 05:22Z tonight, made while this cut was being prepared and before I had checked whether CM044 was a cut pin. The board was fresh=18 held=4 RED=0 before it. Landing a CM044 change of any kind re-reds this gate immediately; that is the gate working, not failing. CARRY FORWARD: this commit must be in the first wiki rebuild after v1.0.39 ships, and this row must be DELETED rather than renewed at that point.
